# PennyWise

> High-performance personal finance tracker designed for students and car enthusiasts with telemetry, pit stop expense logging, and budget gauges.

## Features
- Cockpit Overview: Real-time balance and burn rate telemetry
- Pit Stop Logs: Detailed transaction tracking with UPI, Cash, and Card payment methods
- Academy Track: Academic semester fee milestones and installments
- RPM Fuel Budget: Target monthly spending limit with tachometer warning indicators
- Telemetry: Recharts visual cash flow analytics and category breakdowns
- Tuning: Account settings, data isolation, and clean state resets
